userWorkspace.tagline: Every number is computed. Every claim is cited. Every reading can be checked.
userWorkspace.disclaimer: Astronomical positions are computed deterministically; traditional interpretive meanings are not scientifically proven to predict events and are offered for reflection and cultural exploration.
userWorkspace.workspaceIntro: Calculate your natal chart and inspect the placements behind it.
userWorkspace.profilesIntro: Manage the saved birth details used for chart calculations.
userWorkspace.preferencesIntro: Set your calculation and calendar preferences.
userWorkspace.privacyBody: You can delete individual saved profiles in Birth Profiles. Account export and deletion are planned.
userWorkspace.profileLoadFailed: Could not load birth profiles. Try again.
userWorkspace.profileSaveFailed: Could not save the profile. Check the birth details and try again.
userWorkspace.profileDeleteFailed: Could not delete the profile. Try again.
userWorkspace.chartCalculated: Chart calculated from the saved profile.
userWorkspace.selectProfileForChart: Create or select a saved birth profile to calculate its chart.
userWorkspace.readyToCalculate: Ready to calculate from this saved profile.
userWorkspace.lagnaSensitivityBody: Lagna is {distance}° from a sign boundary. A small change in the birth time may change the rising sign.

chartIssues.bsPending: This Bikram Sambat date is awaiting conversion. If you know the verified Gregorian date, edit the profile and enter it in AD.
chartIssues.unknownTime: A natal chart needs a birth time. Edit the profile if you can provide an exact or approximate time.
chartIssues.incomplete: Birth details are incomplete. Edit the profile and check the date, time, place, coordinates, and time zone.
chartIssues.dateRange: This birth date is outside the supported calculation range. Check the saved date for errors.
chartIssues.auth: Your session has expired. Sign in again to calculate the chart.
chartIssues.forbidden: You do not have permission to calculate this chart. Sign in with the account that owns the profile.
chartIssues.missing: The saved profile is unavailable. Reload your profiles.
chartIssues.validation: The calculation inputs could not be validated. Check the calculation settings and the profile’s date, time, and time zone.
chartIssues.server: The chart service could not complete the calculation. Try again in a moment.
chartIssues.network: The chart service could not be reached. Check your connection and retry.
chartIssues.profileChanged: The profile changed while the chart was being calculated. Reload your profiles and calculate again.

userWorkspace.bsDisplayPending: Bikram Sambat display is not available yet.
userWorkspace.scopeDashaOnly: The Dasha year length changes. Planetary placements stay the same.
userWorkspace.scopeFullChart: These settings require a new chart calculation.
userWorkspace.sampleBannerBody: This example uses synthetic birth details from London, 15 May 2015. It is separate from your saved profiles.
userWorkspace.approxBannerBody: This profile uses an approximate birth time. Lagna and whole-sign house placements remain sensitive to clock-time uncertainty (tracked independently from the 0.5° Lagna boundary check).
userWorkspace.unknownTimeBannerBody: A natal chart needs an exact or approximate birth time. Moon-only charts are unavailable.
userWorkspace.awaitingRecomputeBody: Restore the sample settings to view the saved snapshot.
userWorkspace.dashaOnlyNotice: Dasha year length updated for future calculations.
userWorkspace.tableCaption: Sidereal planetary placements and Lagna from ChartFacts
userWorkspace.authRequiredBannerTitle: Authentication Required to Manage Saved Profiles
userWorkspace.authRequiredBannerBody: No active session token is present. Sign in or create an account to save encrypted profiles; you may still inspect the illustrative synthetic sample.
userWorkspace.authFormLockedNotice: Authentication required: sign in before saving or updating profiles via /api/v1/profiles.
userWorkspace.sessionUnavailableBannerBody: Unable to verify or refresh your active authentication session right now. Your loaded profiles and unsaved form entries remain intact while waiting to retry.
userWorkspace.logoutConfirmBody: This signs you out on every device. Other devices may keep access for up to 15 minutes. If the request fails, this session stays active.
userWorkspace.logoutOutcomeConfirmed: You signed out of this session.
userWorkspace.logoutOutcomeUnconfirmed: You signed out in this browser. We could not confirm that the session ended on the service.
userWorkspace.logoutOutcomeNetworkError: You signed out in this tab. A connection error prevented us from confirming sign-out in this browser.
userWorkspace.logoutAllConfirmedNotice: You signed out on all devices. Other devices may keep access for up to 15 minutes.
userWorkspace.logoutAllFailedNotice: Global sign-out did not complete. This session is still active.
userWorkspace.deleteConfirmPrompt: Permanently delete this saved birth profile? Its encrypted birth date, time, place, and coordinates will be removed immediately.
userWorkspace.chatContractBody: When app/ai/* and /charts/{id}/chat are implemented, the LLM receives only allowlisted derived facts and retrieved knowledge chunks—never ChartMetadata timestamps, Julian Day, coordinates, or raw birth details.
userWorkspace.chatAllowlistTitle: Allowlisted Payload Preview (derived facts + conventions only)
userWorkspace.chatExcludedList: ChartMetadata (datetime_utc_iso, julian_day, utc_offset_hours), birth_profiles raw dates/times, latitude, longitude, timezone, and user identity.
userWorkspace.dashaContractBody: Three-level drill-down (Mahadasha → Antardasha → Pratyantardasha) awaiting backend app/calc/dasha.py implementation. No period dates are fabricated.
userWorkspace.dashaHierarchyLabel: Hierarchy: All MD > MD > AD > PD
userWorkspace.transitsContractBody: Current planetary transits relative to natal Lagna/Moon and upcoming sign ingresses await backend app/calc/transits.py and /charts/{id}/transits implementation.
userWorkspace.unavailableNoChart: Unavailable until verified ChartFacts are loaded for a known birth time.
userWorkspace.formSubtitle: Store the original birth-date calendar separately from your display preference. Unknown birth times never substitute a guessed clock time.
userWorkspace.formLabelPlaceholder: e.g., Personal Chart or Family Member
userWorkspace.formTimeUnknownNote: Time disabled: unknown birth time omits local clock time and suppresses Lagna/houses.
userWorkspace.formPlacePlaceholder: Enter city, district, or locality explicitly
userWorkspace.formCoordinatesNote: Enter decimal coordinates and a canonical region-based IANA timezone manually. Coordinates are never inferred from the place name until a geocoding provider is approved.
